unsupported: Customers include engine builders, racers, and restoration shops needing reliable sealing for performance valve trains, as well as hobbyists and professionals storing or shipping engines.

The spacers are used with factory or aftermarket valve covers on applications ranging from street rods to circle-track engines, while the storage kits serve both long-term preservation and short-term paint-shop masking.
The founder’s original goal was to eliminate the need for tall valve covers, and the current catalog reflects that focus on direct-fit, American-made components with optional custom branding.
